verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-payable API: agents can pay via MPP without an API key or signup. It publishes machine-readable entry points, including an llms.txt index (HTTP 200), an agents.md developer page, a UCP integration and an MCP server, so an agent can find and use this one paid service. However, the pack never shows Channel3 publishing or appearing in a directory or discovery index of payable services and APIs, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: a published directory or discovery index of payable services, evidence of listing in an MPP or other payable-service registry, a machine-readable OpenAPI or service manifest, independent corroboration of agent discovery.
